meta.title: Optimize Chat API/Job schema transfer by removing HTTP payload overhead
meta.body_summary: Optimize Chat API/Job by removing large schemaData from HTTP payloads, instead fetching schema via repository pattern within the job context, reducing network overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Devin removed schemaData from HTTP payloads and implemented job-side retrieval using repository pattern; merged after two approve reviews without benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 66 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted payload optimization that merged quickly with minimal review friction.

review_details.concern_detail: No blocking review concerns; maintainers approved with LGTM and thumbs-up.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing schemaData from HTTP payloads reduces network overhead and speeds up API calls.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: API payload optimization and repository pattern refactor is within Devin's capability for this codebase; merge required no benchmark or rigorous performance proof.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers MH4GF and NoritakaIkeda reviewed the code changes and approved without requesting benchmarks or additional evidence.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurements or benchmarks provided; only narrative claims of reduced overhead.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR merged without issues.

core_change_summary.description: In chatJobs.ts, schemaData is now fetched via repositories.schema.getSchema() instead of passed through HTTP; removed schemaData from API route schema validation and frontend service calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Agent package changes add schema validation fallback and type adjustments; Chat.tsx removes schemaData prop.
change_trajectory: Initial commit removing schemaData from API and frontend, adding repository fetch in job.
Follow-up commit fixes TypeScript/linting errors in agent package.
Final commit simplifies error handling in job file.
